split_rule: Sort all old score_fit Dialogue IDs by SHA-256 of seed|dialogue|id; first 20 engineering, next 75 pilot_fit, final 60 pilot_eval. Frozen before candidate inspection.
target_rule: Use one utterance per Pilot Dialogue by SHA-256 of seed|target|Dialogue ID|Utterance ID. No confidence, outcome, label or eligibility stratification.
old_rule: Previous fixed lowercase allowlist and minimum length five, one interior adjacent swap, evaluation on engineering text only.
new_rule: Expand the fixed neutral allowlist to common function and discourse words and admit eligible four-letter forms. Recognize sentence-initial capitalization on allowlisted words only. Retain whole token, first and last letter, and exactly one interior adjacent swap in each variant. Exclude contractions, compounds, and Unicode apostrophe/dash boundaries.
collision_guard: Reject edited words already observed as ASCII word types in engineering Dialogue text, or as a fixed allowlisted, protected or extra known collision word. This guard leaves AI review necessary for contextual real-word collisions.
engineering_evaluation: Compare candidate K2 coverage on all engineering utterances and on one independently hash-selected utterance per engineering Dialogue. Candidate counts only; do not use labels, prediction scores or inference. Keep exactly one candidate rule and no reselection after review.
